title: Universal Work Reduction Discovery and Execution
purpose: Extend the Work Reduction Framework into the canonical discovery, prioritization, and execution interface for all governed work across the Acellorator.
principles: Every governed work item SHALL be discoverable.
Every work item SHALL belong to exactly one primary domain.
Every work item SHALL expose an executable lifecycle.
Queues are projections of governed work, not independent authorities.

queue_projection_rule.statement: Queues SHALL be treated as filtered projections of governed work rather than independent governance authorities.

discovery_rules.text: Every governed work artifact SHALL be discoverable through the Work Reduction Framework.
Every queue, campaign, review registry, induction registry, validator backlog, and debt registry SHALL identify its governing work domain.
No governed work SHALL exist outside the Work Reduction Framework.

execution_rules.text: Reduction SHALL operate on governed work items rather than directly on queue files.
Blocking dependencies SHALL be reported before execution begins.
Work reduction SHALL prioritize dependency resolution when it unlocks downstream governed work.
Completion SHALL update the originating registry and refresh all projected queue views.

success_criteria: All governed work is discoverable through the framework.
All queues become projections rather than independent authorities.
Every work item reports execution readiness.
Dependency analysis is available before reduction.
A single command grammar operates across all departments.
